get_reward_for_space: get the reward value for a named reward space using env.reward[space_name]
reset_reward_view: reset the RewardView and all registered reward spaces for a new benchmark episode
add_reward_space: add a new Reward space to the RewardView so it can be queried by name
inspect_reward_spaces: inspect the available reward spaces and their range via env.reward.spaces
call_reward_by_name: call a dynamically bound reward method by name such as env.reward.codesize()
